title: HiDrive: A Closed-Loop Benchmark for High-Level Autonomous Driving
reasoning: The HiDrive benchmark explicitly incorporates and evaluates 'moral reasoning' and 'ethical reasoning' as core components of its assessment for autonomous driving systems. It includes specific metrics such as the 'ethics score (ES)' and evaluates capabilities in 'value-priority dilemmas' (e.g., prioritizing human safety in unavoidable collisions) and 'pedestrian-related ethics'.
